title: Concept
description: Adds various chaotic features that were suggested to me!
body:
# Concept  

## Features  
- **Switched boat velocity**
  - Boats are now fast on land and slow on water.
- **Piss...**  
  - Replaces water with... piss... (Thanks Dark...)  
  - Added Piss effect  
    - Switches `cos` and `sin` around for entities with the effect.  
    - You get this effect when in contact with water, or when you are effected by any potion.  
- OH NO! SOMEONE POISONED THE VINES!
  - Touching a vine now makes you light-headed.
- You're a really, really bad firebender...
  - Fire Charges can now be used like wind charges... but with fire. 🔥
  - There is a chance of you spawning a fireball when attacking an entity, every time this fails your chances for the next attack go up.
- Added Herobrine
  - uh well kind-of? Mannequins will now spawn around the player in the distance, if seen they will teleport somewhere else.
  - Mannequins will spawn with skins.


_This was made for a [challenge stream](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wMwF7x9nGeg) out of suggested ideas (that's why it's so chaotic)_
